SUMMARY
Senior Business Analyst with 5+ years of experience across BFSI, Regulatory Compliance, Digital Transformation, 
HR-Tech and AI-driven solutions, with strong experience in translating complex business requirements into functional 
specifications and technology deliverables.
Currently experienced in supporting Citi Bank programs through Genpact, working across Risk & Compliance, 
Regulatory Transformation, Data Governance, Control Governance and Business Process Transformation. Strong 
expertise in requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, user stories, process mapping, gap analysis, 
stakeholder management, UAT and requirements traceability.
Experienced in working with senior stakeholders including VPs, A VPs and Directors, as well as cross-functional teams 
across Business, Technology, Data Engineering, QA and Analytics. Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum, Kanban and 
Waterfall delivery methodologies, with hands-on exposure to JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Visio and 
Lucidchart.

EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst – BFSI | Citi Bank Dec 2024 – Apr 2026
GENP ACT Bengaluru
• Supported Citi Bank's Digital Transformation and Regulatory Compliance initiatives, working with business 
and technology stakeholders to translate regulatory and business requirements into actionable technology 
deliverables.
• Led end-to-end requirement engineering, conducting requirement elicitation sessions with 15+ global 
stakeholders and converting complex business requirements into BRDs, FRDs, user stories and functional 
specifications.
• Worked within the Risk & Compliance / Control Governance environment, supporting Second Line of Defense 
(2LOD) activities across business functions and ensuring alignment with governance and regulatory 
requirements.
• Translated regulatory requirements covering areas such as BSA/AML, KYC and Dodd-Frank into business 
requirements, process changes and Agile user stories.
• Performed AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, gap analysis and process modelling using Visio and Lucidchart to identify 
process inefficiencies, control gaps and opportunities for operational improvement.
• Collaborated with 1LOD, 2LOD and 3LOD stakeholders, Data Engineering, QA and Analytics teams to drive 
requirements clarification, issue resolution and delivery across geographically distributed teams.
• Managed 5 concurrent workstreams within an Agile/Scrum environment, supporting sprint planning, backlog 
grooming, requirement prioritization and delivery tracking.
• Maintained the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) to ensure complete traceability between business 
requirements, functional requirements, test scenarios and delivered functionality.
• Planned and coordinated UAT activities, including test scenario preparation, business validation, defect triage 
and stakeholder sign-off, contributing to zero critical defect leakage into production.
• Performed SQL-based data validation to verify data accuracy and integrity for regulatory reporting and 
governance requirements.
• Supported Data Governance and Data Quality initiatives, including data lineage documentation, data mapping 
and validation of critical reporting data.
• Conducted Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for business and process issues and coordinated with relevant 
stakeholders to define corrective actions.
• Developed Power BI and Tableau dashboards for program leadership, improving visibility into project health 
and reducing manual status-reporting effort by approximately 40%.
• Managed stakeholder communication with VP, A VP and Director-level stakeholders, ensuring timely escalation, 
decision-making and resolution of project risks and issues.
• Supported risk and issue management, change management and delivery governance across multiple 
transformation initiatives.
Business Analyst – ERP | HRMS & Payroll Management System Aug 2022 – Sep 2024
AMAZE INC Bengaluru
• Led business analysis activities for a cloud-based HRMS and Payroll ERP, covering requirements gathering, 
process analysis, functional documentation, testing and implementation.
• Conducted requirement elicitation sessions with business stakeholders and translated HR and Finance 
requirements into BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and process flows.
• Developed AS-IS / TO-BE process maps and wireframes to define future-state workflows for payroll 
automation and employee self-service modules.
• Collaborated with Product, UI/UX and Engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve functional gaps and 
ensure alignment between business expectations and technical implementation.
• Managed product backlog and supported sprint planning, backlog grooming and prioritization within a Scrum 
environment using JIRA.
• Coordinated UAT cycles, including test case preparation, defect triage, business validation and stakeholder 
sign-off.
• Analysed payroll calculation processes and supported implementation of automated calculation logic, 
contributing to a 30% reduction in manual payroll errors.
• Worked closely with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle from requirements and design 
through development, testing and go-live.
Business Analyst – AI Hiring Automation Project Feb 2022 – Aug 2022
RCHILLI INC Mohali
• Gathered and analysed business and functional requirements for a SaaS-based AI-driven recruitment and hiring 
automation platform.
• Worked on requirements related to Resume Parser and automated candidate data extraction, focusing on 
improving accuracy and usability of candidate information.
• Developed functional specifications, workflow diagrams and process documentation for automated recruitment 
processes.
• Collaborated with technical teams to translate business requirements into system functionality and identify 
process improvements.
• Analysed recruitment workflows and supported the design of automated candidate matching, screening and data 
extraction processes.
